body.name: Live-label right-congruence state
body.construction: At cut \(\ell\), a prefix with used dictionary \(D\) is represented by \((A_\ell,b_\ell)=(D\cap B_\ell,|D\setminus B_\ell|)\); after choosing signature \(S_{\pi(\ell+1)}(r)\), set \(W=A_\ell\cup S_{\pi(\ell+1)}(r)\), \(A_{\ell+1}=W\cap B_{\ell+1}\), and \(b_{\ell+1}=b_\ell+|W\setminus B_{\ell+1}|\), retaining at most two backpointers per state.
